_purpose: Synthetic `element_survey` recording, read by checks/check-brief-compose.sh through KOGAKI_ELEMENTS_PAYLOAD as the served enumeration the Brief mint resolves its command-line addresses against (kogaki#1116). It CARRIES THE SAME FIVE MEMBERS as checks/fixtures/survey/lone-tag-member.json beside it, with the same slugs, tags and journey-on-alpha shape, so the Brief this member mints is the one it minted before the argument form changed and the cases downstream of the mint are exercised against the same material. What differs is the IDENTITY: each record carries the served address `unit_id` and its own `content_hash`, which is what a Strand's cite is composed from since the commit pin was deprecated. The hashes are patterned rather than real -- nothing here resolves against a substrate, and a plausible-looking hash would invite a reader to think it did.
